description: Localhost testing with UnderPass: open localhost, staging and private sites on 3,000+ real browsers and devices from a one-click desktop app.

items.q: How do I test localhost on cloud browsers?
items.a: Start UnderPass from the desktop app, then open your localhost URL in a TestMu AI browser or device.

items.q: Do I need the command line?
items.a: No. The UnderPass desktop app starts the tunnel with one click, no CLI.
Yes. It opens an outbound connection only, so no inbound firewall ports are needed.

items.q: Can I test localhost on a real iPhone?
items.a: Yes. Real devices route through the tunnel too.
Yes. Selenium, Playwright, Cypress and Appium runs can use the tunnel.
